text: The better-known test is the mass ceiling. The chain gives a Brown-Bethe maximum of about one and a half times the Sun's mass, then says that approximately two times the Sun's mass would be the safe threshold for a serious obstacle. The strongest qualifying single star measurement is PSR J0740 plus 6620 at 2.08 plus minus 0.07 times the Sun's mass. It clears 2.00 at the quoted 68.3% level, but not at the stricter 95.4% level used by our sealed rule. So this limb reaches serious doubt, not strict falsification. The literal 1.5 ceiling is still contradicted. Three qualifying timing systems sit securely above it.
